title: measurement_policy.v1
description: Complete, explicit measurement policy with no inferred defaults. Required instruments and quorum bound availability. Sparse stratified cells and calibration views stay not_measured. Brier remains available for valid pairs; pass-to-the-k requires enough samples. The seed references its canonical contract.

required_instruments.description: Instrument names whose measured signal the read requires. Set semantics: unique, order-free. The schema does not tie its length to quorum; the availability module does.

quorum.description: Minimum number of required instruments that must report a measured signal before any read is scored; fewer is not_measured.

min_cell_n.description: Minimum case count per stratum or cell; a cell below it is not_measured.

min_bin_n.description: Minimum points per calibration bin before ECE is reported; below it the ECE view is not_measured and Brier remains.
